title: Rewrite tests that don't actually exercise the repository/provider they claim to test

evidence.quote: skip: 'Bundled JSON removed — content now fetched from cloud storage',

why: content_repository_impl_test.dart's 'in-memory operations' group re-implements ContentRepositoryImpl's filter/search logic with local .where() calls instead of calling filterByLevel/search/getContentByRef — a regression in the real nikud-stripping cache or level-matching would not be caught here. Its 'empty search returns empty list' test is a pure tautology that doesn't reference the repository at all. Its entire 'JSON parsing contract' group is skipped with a now-false premise (ContentRepositoryImpl.getContentForCurriculum still loads rootBundle.loadString('assets/content/hierarchy/$key.json'), and 14 such files exist) and even unskipped would fail immediately since its own File('assets/content/$filename') omits the 'hierarchy/' path segment. Separately, content_tile_search_providers_test.dart's 'P2. empty query' test allocates a ProviderContainer and disposes it but never calls container.read(...) — its assertion only exercises the hand-written fake repository directly, not contentSearchProvider as the test name claims. The sibling file content_repository_impl_logic_test.dart (also in this batch) shows the correct pattern — a fake subclass that only stubs asset loading and calls the real repository methods — so real coverage exists elsewhere, but these weaker duplicates sit alongside it giving false confidence.
recommendation: Delete the 'in-memory operations' and skipped 'JSON parsing contract' groups from content_repository_impl_test.dart (superseded by content_repository_impl_logic_test.dart); add one small always-on smoke test that loads and parses every assets/content/hierarchy/*.json file; fix the P2 test to call container.read(contentSearchProvider(...).future) with an empty query.
acceptance_criteria: mutating ContentRepositoryImpl.search's nikud-stripping or filterByLevel's level-matching logic causes a red test in this suite after the rewrite
dart test shows 0 permanently-skipped groups in content_repository_impl_test.dart, or the skip reason is corrected and carries a Linear id

corrections: Finding states '14 such files exist' under assets/content/hierarchy/*.json; actual count via find is 15. Does not affect the core claim that the skip reason is false and the code path is live.
